detail.command:
set -e
echo '=== STATUS ==='
git status --short
if git status --short | grep -q .; then echo 'Working tree is not clean'; exit 1; fi
if grep -R -nE '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)' src/ui; then echo 'Conflict markers remain'; exit 1; fi
echo '=== TYPECHECK ==='
npm run typecheck
echo '=== UI TESTS ==='
npm run test:ui
echo '=== BUILD ==='
npm run build
echo '=== FINAL STATUS ==='
git status --short
